gaps.sentence: This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
We managed ___ everyone before the storm hit.
He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: I saw him ___ the wall and disappear into the garden.
gaps.explanation: see/hear + object + bare infinitive = the complete action; -ing = the action in progress. Both readings possible here; the bare infinitive is expected.

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the fire before it spread.
gaps.explanation: manage takes the to-infinitive: managed to put out.

gaps.sentence: Renovating the kitchen involved ___ a wall.
You risk ___ your licence if you drink and drive.
They managed ___ the deadline despite the strike.
